conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Brian Watson from the IRS Taxpayer Assistance Program. I see your file here and wanted to congratulate you, you're eligible for a $2,800 tax refund under the new COVID stimulus relief. May I confirm a few details with you?
Oh, really? That sounds great. I wasn't expecting that. Sure, what do you need?

Excellent. Just to confirm, you filed your taxes as a self-employed contractor last year, correct? We want to ensure your gig income, like rideshare or food delivery, was properly reported to maximize your refund.
Yeah, I drive for several apps and do some deliveries. I tried to file on my own, but I'm not sure I did it right.

That's very common. No worries, we're here to help. The IRS recently flagged several accounts for additional verification to prevent fraud, especially with self-employment income. Before we issue your refund, we need to complete a quick identity and processing check.
Okay, is that complicated? I can't afford to miss out on a refund.
Not at all. To start, can you confirm your full name, date of birth, and the address you used on your last tax return?
Sure, it's Mia Hunter, January 15, 1988, and 45 Maple Street, Portland, Oregon.

Thank you, Mia. Now, as part of the enhanced IRS procedures, there's a one-time refundable processing fee of $195 to verify your identity and expedite your $2,800 payment. Once we receive the fee, you'll get your refund direct-deposited within 24 hours.
Wait, I have to pay a fee to get my refund? That doesn't sound right.

I understand your concern. IRS policy changes this year require this step for gig workers to safeguard against fraudulent claims. If the fee isn't processed today, your refund will be put on indefinite hold, and you may be flagged for a compliance audit.
A compliance audit? What's that mean for me?
A compliance audit could result in penalties or fines if discrepancies are found, and may even delay future stimulus payments. It's best to resolve this promptly to avoid any issues.
Yikes, I can't afford any problems. How do I pay the fee?
For your convenience, you can pay using Zelle, Cash App, or by purchasing a set of Walmart gift cards totaling $195. Which method works best for you?
I have Cash App, I guess.
Perfect. Please send $195 to the IRS expedited verification handle: $IRSRefunds2024. Let me know as soon as you've sent it, so I can process your refund.
Alright, hold on while I send it... Okay, I just sent $195 to that handle. Did you get it?
Checking now... Yes, payment received. Thank you, Mia. Now, to finalize the transfer, I need your bank account and routing number to deposit your refund directly.
Okay, it's 011234567 for the account and 021000021 for the routing number.

Thank you. I'll start processing your refund. One last thing, before we release the payment, IRS policy requires a two-factor authentication code sent to your phone. Please read it to me as soon as it arrives.
Alright, I'll keep an eye out for the code. Should I expect the refund today?

Absolutely. As long as you provide the code right away, your $2,800 refund will be in your account within 24 hours. If there are any delays, I'll call you back to resolve them. Thank you for your cooperation.
